scope: Laser attachment following, optional-visual failure isolation, and a Tools-only native-attack fixture

observations: Native initial lifetime is 0.7 seconds; DestroyParticle(false) lets segments fade after script ownership ends at 0.18 seconds.
Old world-coordinate endpoints could freeze during that unowned fade. The change binds CP9/CP0 to source and CP1 to target with PATTACH_POINT_FOLLOW, then retires old segments immediately.

coverage: Native source and target attachment binding; no world-CP overwrite while bound
Attachment fallback, including partial source binding
Target switch, target killed by another attacker, relocation reset and destruction
CreateParticle/binding/fallback-update/DestroyParticle/ReleaseParticleIndex failures do not interrupt damage or release of other owned handles
Tools-only fixture guard, rejected arbitrary shell option, empty-area preflight, no player/building registration/global events/direct ApplyDamage
Async cancellation, delayed callbacks, loading deadline, runtime timeout and independent cleanup
Native movement retries only when the existing movement stopped, with 0.35-second throttle
Default native ranged shell removes modifier_creep_piercing and receives production mystery row, skills, modifiers and Storm visuals

simulated_30_seconds.note: Deterministic Lua mock call counts, not engine frame-time measurements.

successful_run.note: This first successful engine run still had the native creep damage-class modifier. The final fixture removes it; do not treat these HP drops as a balance baseline.

rejected_hypotheses: Stopping only the production auto-attack retry think for 5 seconds did not make the NO_ATTACK proxy attack.
Changing only that proxy to MOVE_GROUND for 5 seconds did not help.
Explicit facing, an X-aligned moving route, and stopping the target also failed for that proxy.
Replacing only the initial unit shell with a native ranged attacker succeeded with the same production AI, modifiers, visuals and Y-axis moving route. No production AI change was made.

four_tower_confirmation.creep_damage_modifier_removed: The root test script removed modifier_creep_piercing one frame after START; the final fixture removes it at creation.

final_fixture_visual_confirmation.creep_damage_modifier_removed: By the final fixture at creation, before production attack modifiers start.

engine_validation.limitation: This validates real native attacks, moving targets, entity CP binding and isolated fixture cleanup. It does not validate production economic upgrades or full-wave performance. Frame-time measurements are recorded separately by the root integration task.
